_note: Needs-attention rules. A label on an open ticket puts it on the card under a kind, ranked (lower first); the ticket's assignee is who has to move. 'you' is the login the wizard named. A project overrides any field in <project>/.cockpit/plugins/github.attention.json with the same shape. Note: a ROUTING label (needs:fleet) is not a stuck state and must not be listed.

needs:click.verb: needs someone to do it by hand

needs:evidence.verb: needs evidence before it can move

titleTags._note: a tag in a ticket TITLE that names who must move, resolved through the people map by login - e.g. "[NEEDS SAM": "octocat". A project adds its own in its override file; none by default.
